svg.title: Replay verification and trust model
svg.desc: The contract never trusts a claimed result. It takes the issued run ticket and the action log, rejects malformed logs, replays the run with a Rust port of the TypeScript game and derives the result itself. 600 golden vectors played by the TypeScript game keep the two implementations identical in cargo test.

g.title: guards
g.text: TooFast: at least actions / 16 ledgers since start
veteran still owned by the player

g.title: actions
g.text: one byte per action, at most 2048

g.title: replay
g.text: applies the actions one by one

g.title: checks
g.text: RunIncomplete: log ends before extraction or death

g.title: result
g.text: floor, score, relics, HP left, rank key
nothing is read from the client

g.title: rejected
g.text: the transaction fails with a contract error
nothing is written, the open run is kept

g.title: legit
g.text: consumes the open run (no second claim)
